lines.text: This is Glomus. A little living landscape, and an A.I. that reshapes it on a whim.
Point at a spot, and say what you want.
The model runs right here, on this P.C. It looks around, tests its plan in a quick simulation, fixes what's wrong, then commits.
One sentence, and the ridge has a waterfall.
Whims can be about behavior, not just shape.
Glowing moss, creeping along every bank the water touches.
Or about time. A wildfire that burns for one minute, then goes out.
You can watch it think, in the sidebar.
And nothing stops. Fire, moss and water all run on the same threads, so they tangle.
Every whim is a skein. Switch it off, erase it,
Ten whims. One small world. Four minutes, squeezed into forty-five seconds.
